SELECT
  CASE WHEN agg.cnt1 > 1071 THEN agg.avg_tax1 ELSE agg.avg_net1 END AS bucket1,
  CASE WHEN agg.cnt2 > 39161 THEN agg.avg_tax2 ELSE agg.avg_net2 END AS bucket2,
  CASE WHEN agg.cnt3 > 29434 THEN agg.avg_tax3 ELSE agg.avg_net3 END AS bucket3,
  CASE WHEN agg.cnt4 > 6568 THEN agg.avg_tax4 ELSE agg.avg_net4 END AS bucket4,
  CASE WHEN agg.cnt5 > 21216 THEN agg.avg_tax5 ELSE agg.avg_net5 END AS bucket5
FROM reason
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt1,
    AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_tax1,
    AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS avg_net1,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt2,
    AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_tax2,
    AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS avg_net2,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt3,
    AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_tax3,
    AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_net3,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt4,
    AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_tax4,
    AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS avg_net4,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt5,
    AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_tax5,
    AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS avg_net5
  FROM store_sales
) AS agg
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
